description: Files directly in a module's application/ folder (backend.md section 3 rule 3: the last resort for shared application logic). Each entry is '<module>/application/<file>.ts' with a 'reason': the step of rule 3 that was tried and why it did not apply. A new file fails tests/architecture/api/pinned.test.ts until it is recorded here in the same pull request. The Epic aimed for an empty list; one collaborator remains, with the reason below.

executions/application/run-lookup-reques.reason: Steps 1 to 5 tried: its steps are one transaction across two aggregates (the Run and its lookup), so they fit on neither one (1); no infrastructure capability is involved (2); the five entry points that request a lookup (refresh, failing checks, review comments, Follow-up refresh, daily refresh) do not share their other steps, so they are not one use case (3); the answer is needed at once, so it cannot be a job or event (4); the steps are too many to repeat (5).
